seal.statement: Implement Package H4 (invocation recovery and cancellation contract) under standard-http-service-api: scope keyed HTTP invocations to authenticated tenant, principal, and stable mount/binding identity; pin the admitted bindingVersionId at first admission on an Idempotency-Key so retries consume the pinned revision even after a mount update while new keys use the current ready revision; reject conflicting semantic inputs or conflicting explicit revision selection with INVOCATION_CONFLICT (HTTP 409); enforce the retention window with a typed INVOCATION_EXPIRED outcome; prevent automatic reruns after uncertain handler execution (INVOCATION_AMBIGUOUS, HTTP 503); and support multiple authorized waiters on an in-flight keyed invocation so a disconnected waiter detaches without cancelling work still owned by remaining waiters while cancelling when all waiters disconnect or explicit cancellation occurs.

text: Implement H4 HTTP invocation recovery, scoped durable idempotency keys, pinned mount revisions across retry and in-flight updates, retention window expiry, uncertain execution fencing, and multi-waiter cancellation ownership with end-to-end Hono WASM tests

Independently verified Quest h4-http-invocation-recovery-and-cancellation against solve/specs/standard-http-service-api/requirements.md (Sections 5.2, 5.3, and 7.1 items 7-8) and docs/steering/rules.md. Confirmed: (1) RequestCellHttpAdapter, request-cell-routing-contract.js, runtime-service-request-cell-handler.js, and RequestCellInvocationOwner scope keyed HTTP invocations to authenticated tenantId, principal, and stable mount/binding identity (bindingId), pin bindingVersionId at first admission, and hash semantic request intent while ignoring stripped hop-by-hop and credential headers; (2) same-intent retries replay completed responses from the durable journal without re-executing the compiled Hono WASM component, including across mount updates (bv-1 -> bv-2), after bv-1 replica retirement, and across fresh adapter instances, while new keys route to bv-2; (3) changed body bytes (including byte-distinct JSON with identical parsed meaning), query/URL, method, application headers, or explicit bindingVersionId under the same key fail with INVOCATION_CONFLICT (HTTP 409); (4) authentication runs before replay (revoked credentials fail with HTTP 401) and retained responses are isolated across principals; (5) retries past retentionWindowMs fail with INVOCATION_EXPIRED (HTTP 410); (6) uncertain execution after completion-journal failure or post-start cancellation fails with INVOCATION_AMBIGUOUS (HTTP 503) and never automatically reruns the handler on retry; (7) multi-waiter cancellation ownership (CANCELLED, HTTP 499) detaches a single disconnected waiter without cancelling work owned by remaining waiters and aborts the invocation when all waiters disconnect or cancelInvocation is called; and (8) legacy request_v1 durable journal witnesses, the H4 guard (metric=0), all 7 end-to-end H4 tests, eslint, guideline checkers, audit:file-size, and complexity ratchets pass with 0 violations.
